description: This file contains functions and types related to detecting, managing, and cleaning up gateway services across different platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows). It includes logic for identifying services, parsing configuration files, and querying scheduled tasks.

methods.name: renderGatewayServiceCleanupHints
methods.description: Generates platform-specific commands to clean up gateway services based on environment variables and platform.

methods.name: detectMarker
methods.description: Detects if a given content string contains a specific marker ('openclaw' or 'clawdbot').

methods.name: detectMarkerLineWithGateway
methods.description: Detects marker in lines containing 'gateway' within the contents, considering line continuations.

methods.name: hasGatewayServiceMarker
methods.description: Checks if content includes gateway service marker keys and values.

methods.name: isOpenClawGatewayLaunchdService
methods.description: Determines if a launchd service label and contents correspond to an OpenClaw gateway service.

methods.name: isOpenClawGatewaySystemdService
methods.description: Checks if a systemd service name and contents correspond to an OpenClaw gateway service.

methods.name: isOpenClawGatewayTaskName
methods.description: Checks if a Windows scheduled task name matches the OpenClaw gateway task naming pattern.

methods.name: tryExtractPlistLabel
methods.description: Extracts the Label key value from a plist file content.

methods.name: isIgnoredLaunchdLabel
methods.description: Determines if a launchd label should be ignored based on known labels.

methods.name: isIgnoredSystemdName
methods.description: Determines if a systemd service name should be ignored.

methods.name: isLegacyLabel
methods.description: Checks if a label is considered legacy based on its content.

methods.name: collectServiceFiles
methods.description: Collects service files with specific extensions from a directory, filtering by ignored names.

methods.name: scanLaunchdDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for launchd plist files and identifies gateway services.

methods.name: scanSystemdDir
methods.description: Scans a directory for systemd service files and identifies gateway services.

methods.name: parseSchtasksList
methods.description: Parses the output of schtasks list into structured task info.

methods.name: findExtraGatewayServices
methods.description: Main function to find extra gateway services across platforms, with optional deep scan.
